title: SiteGround invoice
description: Structured data of a SiteGround invoice or credit note PDF. Copy values literally from the PDF, use null for values that are not on the PDF and never guess.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number as printed on the PDF, for example 4869562.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR.

payment_method.description: Payment method as printed on the PDF in upper case, for example MASTERCARD, VISA or PAYPAL.

supplier.description: The SiteGround entity that issued the invoice.

customer.description: The customer the invoice is addressed to.

line_items.description: Invoice lines, in the order of the PDF.

totals.description: Invoice totals. Amounts are decimal numbers without currency symbol, negative for credit notes.

vat_rate_percent.description: VAT rate in percent, for example 21 or 0.

scheme.description: VAT scheme: standard (VAT charged), reverse_charge (VAT reverse charge, Art. 196 VAT Directive), exempt or none.

note.description: VAT note as printed on the PDF.

country.description: Country name in English, for example Netherlands.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example NL.

name.description: Name of the person or legal entity.

company.description: Company name, when it differs from the name.

tax_id.description: Local tax ID, for example the Spanish CIF B-87194171.

vat_number.description: EU VAT number without spaces, for example NL814327394B01.

description.description: Line description, copied literally from the PDF.

type.description: Type of line: new (new order), renewal, upgrade, addon (extra service such as Site Scanner or extra storage) or other.

product.description: Product name, for example GrowBig Hosting.

period.description: Period as stated on the PDF, for example 1 year or 1 month.

domain.description: Domain name the line applies to, in lower case and without www, for example example.com.

vat_rate_percent.description: VAT rate in percent, for example 21 or 0.
